NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Saves or shares a card image using your Photos.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Saves a share card image to your Photos.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Been Ages only adds an item's next due date to your calendar when you tap Add to Calendar. It never reads your events.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Been Ages only adds an item's next due date to your calendar when you tap Add to Calendar. It never reads your events.
NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Adds an item's next due date to your calendar.
NSRemindersUsageDescription: Been Ages does not use the Reminders app. Its reminders are local notifications.
NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Been Ages does not use the Reminders app. Its reminders are local notifications.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Been Ages uses the microphone to transcribe your speech on your device so you can add or look up tracked activities, for example by asking when you last changed your toothbrush.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Been Ages uses the microphone to transcribe your speech on your device so you can add or look up tracked activities, for example by asking when you last changed your toothbrush.
